text:
kyle: Starting thread for MeridianHealth POC kickoff. Customer wants to validate clinical note summarization and PHI handling. Tight 30-min call scheduled for tomorrow. Who can join?
ana: I'll be there. Key contacts: VP Data (Dr. Huang), Compliance (Sofia), Platform (Rajat). They emphasized HIPAA and in-region processing.
oliver: Proposed POC scope: 1) PHI-aware summarization with redaction; 2) structured ICD code extraction; 3) latency goal p95 <300ms for single-request. Success criteria: redaction accuracy >98%, extraction F1 >90%, p95 latency target met.
src-bot: [system] Note: healthcare deals require signed BAA before any PHI transfer. Confirm BAA status before ingest.
sec-bot: [automated] Security checklist requested: SOC2, HIPAA compliance status, DPA, BAA steps. Link: https://security.internal/meridian/poctemplate
kyle: For eval assets ask them for 100 deidentified examples and 50 real PHI samples under NDA if they consent. We'll provide a template for labeling. Also confirm storage retention (7 days default for POC?).
ana: They want in-region processing (EU) and KMS with customer keys. If Private required, need network peering and certs.
oliver: Pricing: small Dedicated estimate for private EU deployment ~ $6k/week. If hosted with EU-only region and customer-managed keys possible, we can do hosted with constraints and credits.
kyle: Discovery checklist for call: - Are examples deidentified or PHI? - Expected volume and concurrency - Which outputs must be structured vs freeform? - Retention / deletion policies & logs - Who approves PHI use? - Do they require audit logs integrated to their SIEM?
ana: Add: data ingress method (SFTP, S3 gov, direct DB), any third-party data processors, and whether they require data locality certs.
oliver: Action items:
- kyle: prepare SOW and PHI handling appendix (EOD)
- ana: collect BAA status and coordinate Legal touchpoint
- oliver: prepare eval harness for redaction and ICD mapping + Dedicated cost estimate
- sec-bot: create security checklist (done)
kyle: I'll send invite for 09:00 CET tomorrow and attach SOW draft + security checklist. Keep this thread short; updates only when customer replies.
